source: Resolved chassis/docs web tokens from the SD 5.5 build and the matching committed dist lines, extracted 2026-09-27. "tokens" holds every token under test and every token it looks up, keyed by path. The alias-following cases and the tokens they look up were added from the build of 2026-10-15. The typography, encode and role group cases and the tokens they look up were taken again from the build of 2026-10-18, after the typography families were named by job.

cases.case: borderRadius.base.<component> to base.context, name passes through
object-valued, role size and line height
cases.expected: ("font-family": var(--font-family-prose), "font-weight": var(--font-weight-ui-elegant), "font-size": var(--font-size-lead), "line-height": var(--line-height-lead), "font-style": normal, "letter-spacing": 0rem, "margin-bottom": 0rem, "text-transform": none, "text-decoration": none)

("font-family": var(--font-family-ui), "font-weight": var(--font-weight-ui-strong), "font-size": var(--font-size-ui-md), "line-height": var(--line-height-ui-md), "font-style": normal, "letter-spacing": 0rem, "margin-bottom": 0rem, "text-transform": none, "text-decoration": none)

("font-family": var(--font-family-ui), "font-weight": var(--font-weight-ui-strong), "font-size": var(--font-size-ui-md), "line-height": var(--line-height-ui-md), "font-style": normal, "letter-spacing": 0rem, "margin-bottom": 0rem, "text-transform": none, "text-decoration": none)

("font-family": var(--font-family-prose), "font-weight": var(--font-weight-prose-normal), "font-size": var(--font-size-prose-lg), "line-height": var(--line-height-prose-lg), "font-style": normal, "letter-spacing": 0rem, "margin-bottom": 0rem, "text-transform": none, "text-decoration": none)

cases.case: object-valued, size name passes through, negative letter spacing
cases.expected: ("font-family": var(--font-family-ui), "font-weight": var(--font-weight-ui-mass), "font-size": var(--font-size-website-hero-title), "line-height": 1.25em, "font-style": normal, "letter-spacing": -0.0625rem, "margin-bottom": 0rem, "text-transform": none, "text-decoration": none)

("font-family": var(--font-family-ui), "font-weight": var(--font-weight-ui-normal), "font-size": var(--font-size-website-hero-body), "line-height": 1.5em, "font-style": normal, "letter-spacing": 0rem, "margin-bottom": 0rem, "text-transform": none, "text-decoration": none)

cases.case: object-valued, italic role group weight that holds a value
cases.expected: ("font-family": var(--font-family-prose), "font-weight": 300, "font-size": var(--font-size-blockquote), "line-height": var(--line-height-blockquote), "font-style": italic, "letter-spacing": 0rem, "margin-bottom": 0rem, "text-transform": none, "text-decoration": none)

("font-family": var(--font-family-prose), "font-weight": var(--font-weight-prose-normal), "font-size": var(--font-size-body-lg), "line-height": var(--line-height-body-lg), "font-style": normal, "letter-spacing": 0rem, "margin-bottom": 1.5rem, "text-transform": none, "text-decoration": none)

cases.case: context role family, weight, size and line height
cases.expected: ("font-family": var(--font-family-ui), "font-weight": var(--font-weight-display-strong), "font-size": var(--font-size-title-md), "line-height": var(--line-height-title-md), "font-style": normal, "letter-spacing": 0rem, "margin-bottom": 1rem, "text-transform": none, "text-decoration": none)

cases.case: context role with a size of another group prints its value
context role with a literal line height
heading role group family follows its alias
cases.expected: ("font-family": var(--font-family-display), "font-weight": var(--font-weight-display-mass), "font-size": var(--font-size-h1), "line-height": var(--line-height-h1), "font-style": normal, "letter-spacing": 0rem, "margin-bottom": 0rem, "text-transform": none, "text-decoration": none)

cases.case: line height looks up its font size
role group family names the family it references
role group weight names the weight it references
style part of a role group weight prints its value
role group weight that holds a value prints it
